results.content: Such digital transformation enables businesses to stay competitive in dynamic markets by enhancing operational efficiency, driving innovation and improving customer experiences (Gaglio et al., Citation2022; Leonardi & Treem, Citation2020; Matarazzo et al., Citation2021b). Studies on digital transformation and innovation management have continued to expand in the extant literature (Liguori et al., Citation2024; Marín et al., Citation2023), reflecting the growing interest of researchers in this field (Gradillas & Thomas, Citation2025; Hassan et al., Citation2024). Some reviews, on the other hand, focused on the effect of specific digital technologies, such as artificial intelligence (AI) (Bahoo et al., Citation2023; Mariani et al., Citation2023; Truong & Papagiannidis, Citation2022), digital twins (DTs) (Xin & Wang, Citation2024) and Industry 4.0 (Strazzullo et al., Citation2024) on firm innovation. Recent reviews have further narrowed their focus to emerging types of innovation like data-driven innovation (Wong & Ngai, Citation2024), the digitalization of key functions (e.g. digital marketing) in SMEs (Noer et al., Citation2025), and the methodological approaches used in analyzing digital innovation in SMEs (Secka & Szopik-Depczyńska, Citation2024).

results.title: Agile digital transformation in SMEs: a hybrid prioritization approach
results.content: **Introduction:** Agile Digital Transformation (ADT) represents a new generation of digital transformation that enables small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to adopt iterative and data-driven strategies, enhancing their flexibility, competitiveness, and sustainability. ### 2.3 Digital transformation enablers in SMEs. DT redefines business practices, processes, capabilities, and models that incorporate agility as a core component to guide organizations through this transformation (Li et al., 2021). Final ranking of ADT enablers in SMEs. As shown in Figure 6, Transformational Digital Leadership is the most important and effective enabler, while the Data-Driven, Innovative Business Model is the least important enabler in implementing ADT in SMEs. Using a hybrid methodology that combines SLR, expert-supported Delphi rounds, and the BWM, the study identified nine conceptual enablers that inform ADT planning in SMEs. The resulting indicators represent expert-validated theoretical dimensions, offering theory-informed insights into cost-effective and sustainable transformation pathways.
